data.rationale: The proposal includes the true core (Experience → Baggage allowance → cabin class link, with cabin class as a parameter) but adds route-entry steps (departure/return airports, Check requirements) and parameters not in the true workflow, so it is partly wrong, though the steps are concrete enough to automate.
